messages:
Alyssa: Postmortem follow-up — streaming.chat partial responses + timeouts. Root cause hypothesis: reconnect storm + cache invalidation flapping causing KV lookups to slow down under tail. Need owners for action items: reconnect/backoff, cache consistency, alerting/dashboards, customer comms. @mike @priya @jun @kelsey please ack and add ETA.

mike: ack. I'll own reconnect/backoff and server-side circuit-breaker. Quick plan: add jittered exp backoff, limit concurrent reconnects per-session, surface per-conn metrics. ETA: PR by Thu EOD, canary Mon, full rollout Wed next week.

priya: ack. I'll own alerting + observability. Will add SLO-based alerts for streaming error-rate and stream-latency-99.9, and a dashboard with per-region reconnect rate. ETA: dashboards by Fri, alerts live Mon.

jun: ack. I'll investigate KV cache invalidation pattern. Hypothesis: short TTL + some workloads cause hot-key churn. Will run sampling job and correlation with partial responses. ETA: initial findings by Tue.

kelsey: ack. I'll draft customer comms for impacted customers and prep status note template. Send me brief (1-2 bullets) on ETA once PR schedule confirmed.

Ops-bot: Created follow-up ticket INC-5421 and linked this thread. Assigned: mike, priya, jun, kelsey. Due: 3478912800.

mike: proposed config (WIP):
```
reconnect:
  max_attempts: 6
  base_backoff_ms: 300
  max_backoff_ms: 8000
  jitter: full
  per_session_connect_limit: 4
```
will add server-side guard to deny reconnect bursts from same session id for 30s if failure rate > 50%.

sean: from support — we saw spike in customer tickets between 03:20–03:45 UTC, many with single partial message then silence. I'll collate sample request IDs and drop into INC-5421.

Alyssa: thanks. I'll run weekly check-ins for 3 weeks to watch recurrence patterns. Please add progress updates to INC-5421. If anyone hits a blocker, ping #eng-oncall and tag me. :thumbsup:

mike: noted, will post PR link in thread when ready. :eyes:

priya: will add alert playbook: runbook link will be in ticket and include paging thresholds.

jun: sharing initial sample in ticket later today. if hot-key churn confirmed, propose increasing prefix cache TTL and add async refresh for heavy keys.

kelsey: drafted customer note, sending to Alyssa for review in DM.

Alyssa: closing actionable owner assign step here — owners: mike(reconnect), priya(alerting), jun(cache), kelsey(comms); timelines: PR Thu / dashboards Fri / findings Tue / comms after PR. recurring check-ins weekly x3. Thanks all.
